visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor studio setting. A male player in a white shirt and glasses and a female player in a yellow top sit side-by-side in gaming chairs. They both hold smartphones horizontally, staring intently at the screens while talking. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up on the woman's face as she speaks to the man. The man reacts by touching his hair with one hand while holding his phone with the other. A variety text overlay appears briefly near the bottom while they interact. (3) The screen splits to show a screen recording of a MOBA mobile game in the lower half. Character avatars and health bars move across a green forest map with towers. Flashy combat effects like purple beams and floating damage numbers appear on screen. (4) The man reaches his left hand over to the woman's arm and phone area playfully. She pulls back, laughing, with her mouth wide open and eyes crinkling in a humorous expression. (5) Fast montage of gameplay footage showing multiple character kills in the game interface. Yellow and white damage numbers pop up over characters. (6) The video ends with a shot of both creators laughing together at the camera. Social media icons and IDs are displayed at the bottom of the frame.
